services.desc: HCA has a variety of pavilions and group areas for you and your group to enjoy. Whether you’re coming for a family event or a large corporate picnic, we have the perfect spot for you! HCA Members receive 15% off pavilion and group area bookings!* *Discount not applicable to Confederation Beach Park, Wild Waterworks or wedding rentals. A charcoal BBQ is included with each rental, but you will be required to supply your own charcoal. Additional BBQ’s can be rented for a fee, and is dependent on availability. services.name: Disc Golf
services.desc: Set up like a golf course, disc golf holes wind through fields and forests to reach the basket but played with flying discs rather than clubs and a ball. Disc golf is a great outdoor activity, perfect for individual play, team play, and organized competition. Christie Lake Conservation Area features an 18-hole championship disc golf course. It is open year-round to the public and is free to use with park entry. The course winds through fields and forests, offering a fun and scenic experience for players, both seasoned and beginner. As the third most played course in Ontario it has welcomed nearly 20,000 players and 58,000+ rounds played. Play disc golf at Christie Lake throughout October

services.name: Ice Climbing
services.desc: When the weather permits, HCA allows ice climbing at Tiffany Falls through two organizations. Climbers must be attending a booked session with either the Alpine Club of Canada (ACC) or Muskoka Mountainworks. These organizations are the only permitted ice climbing users, for safety reasons. No individual ice climbing permits will be issued by HCA. Do not access Tiffany Falls without a permit through these

services.name: HCA Day Pass
services.desc: Discover nature close to home and skip the line next time you visit your favourite HCA conservation area! Day passes are now available to be purchased in advance for: Advanced day pass entry can be purchased up to five days before your arrival. A maximum of six people and one vehicle are permitted on each day pass, and it is valid for the whole day. When you arrive at your destination, simply scan the emailed barcode at the gate from your phone. Did you enjoy quick and easy access with your day pass? Consider becoming an HCA Member! services.name: Wildlife Management Committee
services.desc: On May 1st, 2014, the Hamilton Conservation Authority (HCA) Board of Directors approved a staff recommendation that a Wildlife Management Committee be established to develop best management protocols for managing wildlife on HCA lands. The HCA Wildlife Management Committee (WMC) was subsequently formed and included staff from different program areas and divisions, including Ecology and Conservation Area Services, to ensure there were varied perspectives and experiences for the WMC to draw on. The WMC met several times over the 2014-2015 period to review current HCA practices, document existing wildlife management rules and regulations, and consult with experts, agencies and other groups

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Get outside with us this summer! Join our Environmental Education team for a week of outdoor adventure and fun in the Dundas Valley Conservation Area! Each day will hold new and exciting opportunities to discover and explore the plants and animals that call the Dundas Valley home. Throughout the week we will hike the trails, investigate nature artifacts, make crafts, and play lots of games. Come explore the forests, streams, and meadows within Dundas Valley Conservation Area! Each camp day will involve a mix of hiking the trails, playing games, and hands-on exploration of nature artifacts. We structure the day to have a morning and afternoon snack break, as well as lunch. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Explore your favourite conservation area up close and personal from the water! Boating is available at Christie Lake, Fifty Point and Valens Lake. Christie Lake covers 60-hectares and is the perfect spot for a paddle! The area is also equipped with a boat launch at the Marina Pavilion. No gasoline motors allowed on the lake. The area offers docking spaces for 330 boats and a double boat launch. Other marina facilities include a fully serviced gas dock and pump-out station, visitor docks, hydro hook-ups, water, showers, washrooms, and winter storage facilities. Learn more.
